transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose I'm here because... well, I've been noticing a pattern for months now. Just... things happening. My sister’s appointments keep getting moved around. Bills show up wrong. People just happen to forget to call me back. 

Everyone keeps telling me it’s just administrative mistakes, but... I know they’re keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of making decisions. That's really it.
Do you think these mistakes are all connected and part of a larger plan to affect you?

Yes. I mean... I just told you, it's a pattern. I supervise an office for a living, so I know what normal administrative errors look like. These aren't that. 

They're definitely connected. Like I said, they just want to keep me in the dark so I can't make any decisions. I don't really know what else to say about it, it's just what's happening.
Do you believe that the people involved in these mistakes are plotting against you specifically?

I thought I just explained that. Yes. It's... directed at me. They are doing all those things I just mentioned specifically to keep information from me. So I can't make decisions. I don't really want to keep repeating myself.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people cannot hear?
No. I haven't heard anything like that.
Would you say the plot against you is something that could happen in real life?
I don't really know what you mean by that. It *is* real life. People hide things and play politics at work all the time... it's not exactly unheard of. So, yes.
Would you say the people plotting against you are doing so in a way that's unusual or hard for others to understand?
No. I... I don't think so. It's just what I said before. Anyone who has been a supervisor would understand exactly what they're doing. There's nothing unusual about it.
Do you think there's any chance you could be mistaken about people plotting against you?

No. I... I don't think so. I mean, I'm here because I've been seeing the exact same pattern for months now. It's not just my imagination. 

My sister's appointments keep getting moved, the bills show up wrong, people just... "forget" to call me back. And everyone keeps telling me it's just mistakes. But it's not. I know they're keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of the decisions. So... no. I'm not mistaken.
Would you describe the plot against you as something that involves unusual or unlikely events?
No. I... I feel like we just went over this. It's not unlikely at all. It's just normal, everyday things... schedules and paperwork. There's nothing unusual about it.
Would you describe the people plotting against you as being motivated by a reason that most people would find unusual or hard to understand?
No. It's... it's just about control. They want me out of the way so they can do what they want. I don't think that's hard for anyone to understand. It happens all the time.
How long have you believed that people are plotting against you?
About 11 months, I suppose. It started when my sister's health got worse and I had to step in to coordinate her care. That's when I noticed it.
Would you describe the reason you think they're trying to keep you in the dark as something that makes sense to you, but might seem strange or unbelievable to others?
No. I don't think so. It makes sense to me, and... well, I don't see why anyone else would find it strange. It's just people trying to hide their mistakes. That's all it is.
Do you think the people plotting against you are part of a larger group or organization?
I'm not sure. I haven't... no. I don't know anything about some larger organization. It's just the people I have to deal with directly for her care. I haven't noticed anything beyond that.
Do you think it's possible that you might change your mind about people plotting against you in the future?

I don't... no. I don't see how I could. 

It’s not just a feeling, it’s... I’ve been seeing the exact same pattern for months now. Her appointments get moved, the bills show up wrong, people conveniently 'forget' to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me it’s just administrative mistakes, but... I know what's happening. They’re keeping information from me. They're just trying to push me out of the decisions regarding her care. 

So... no. I won't change my mind about what I can clearly see happening.
Have you noticed any other unusual things happening in your life besides the things you mentioned related to your sister's care?
No. Just... just the things with her care. That's all.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't believe people were plotting against you?

Well... yes. I mean, before all this started, I didn't think anything like this was happening. It's just... it's been going on for about 11 months now. That's when her health suddenly got worse and I had to step in and start coordinating everything for her. Before that, things were fine.
Have your beliefs about people plotting against you changed in intensity over the 11 months you've had them?
No. It's... it's just been the same. They've been trying to keep me out of it the whole time.
Have you ever had a time in the past 11 months when you doubted that people were plotting against you?

No. I haven't doubted it. It's... the pattern is just too obvious. Appointments getting moved without telling me, the bills showing up wrong, people suddenly forgetting to call me back. They all say it's just mistakes, but... I know what I see. They're keeping information from me. They want to push me out of her decisions.
Have you ever had a period of even a few days where you didn't think people were plotting against you since this all started 11 months ago?
No. I just told you, it's been constant. I haven't changed my mind about what's going on.
Have you ever had even a short period, like a week, where you felt like maybe people weren't plotting against you?

No. I... I just said that. It hasn't stopped. I've been seeing the same things happen for months now. The appointments, the bills... it's all the same. They can say it's mistakes, but... I know what they're doing. They're trying to push me out.
